snippet.title: Wordbound - Mixed Reality Puzzle Game (feat. The Pineapple Guy 🍍😎) [Official Teaser]
snippet.description:
Wordbound is a mixed reality puzzle game where the world is made of words. Stretch objects until they burst into letter tiles, then remix the tiles to spawn new objects and unscramble the world!

Join the Discord https://discord.gg/jE57PJ9Yta
Follow development on Bluesky https://bsky.app/profile/kettle.games
Learn more at https://kettle.games

This video was part of the 2025 Creature Feature https://www.creature.page/feature
